Brucinum.



Brucine. An alkaloid obtained from the bark and seeds of Strychnos nux
        vomica. C 23  H 26  N 2 O 4 .



Clinical. ─   Headache. Paralysis.



Characteristics. ─   Lepelletier has recorded the
        following effects of 0.02 to 0.90 of a gramme of   Brucinum  .
        Sudden jerking, especially of lower extremities, spreading generally but not accompanied by
        trismus and tetanus, and not extending to Œsophagus and pharynx as with   Strychnia  . Twitching in the paralysed as well as healthy muscles.
        A fever of short duration ends the attacks; after which deep sleep comes on.
